web-root: <WEB_ROOT: repo-relative root of the Angular web project, forward slashes — e.g. src/app/features/widgets>
routing-module: <ROUTING_MODULE: repo-relative path to the routing module the test-host route is added to, forward slashes — e.g. src/app/features/widgets/widgets-routing.module.ts>
routing-module-class: <ROUTING_MODULE_CLASS: exported class name of that routing module — the class whose static components array gains the test-host component — e.g. WidgetsRoutingModule>
test-host-root: <TEST_HOST_ROOT: repo-relative root under which routed <kebab>-test/ host folders and the sandbox module-test component live, forward slashes — e.g. src/app/features/widgets>
route-prefix: <ROUTE_PREFIX: app route segment the test hosts mount under, no leading/trailing slash — the host URL is /<route-prefix>/<kebab>-test — e.g. widgets>
sandbox-host-folder: <SANDBOX_HOST_FOLDER: folder name (under test-host-root) of the long-standing sandbox module-test host that page-tests inject into — e.g. widgets-module-test>
sandbox-host-component: <SANDBOX_HOST_COMPONENT: class name of that sandbox module-test host component page-tests inject into — e.g. WidgetsModuleTestComponent>
route-guards: <ROUTE_GUARDS: comma-separated route-guard class names applied via canActivate on the scaffolded test-host route, or empty for none — e.g. SessionGuard, ScopeGuard>
verify-command: <VERIFY_COMMAND: the shell command that typechecks/builds the stack so a scaffold can be verified before handoff — e.g. npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit>
